lectures.title: Why is the ploughman bigger than the hero? Bruegel's Fall of Icarus
What does a day's work look like? Bruegel's The Harvesters
Why set a holy story in a tax office? Caravaggio's Calling of Saint Matthew
How can pouring milk be monumental? Vermeer's The Milkmaid
Why paint a child's game? Chardin's The House of Cards
Why was a village funeral a scandal? Courbet's A Burial at Ornans
What is gleaning? Millet's The Gleaners
Why were these workers 'vulgar'? Caillebotte's The Floor Scrapers
Who is the barmaid? Manet's A Bar at the Folies-Bergère
Who gets a day off? Seurat's A Sunday on La Grande Jatte

quiz.question: A painter today wants to show a royal wedding the way Bruegel shows Icarus. Which picture follows his method?
choices: The couple huge, a sweeper tiny below
A crowd of guests filling the frame
A sweeper in front, the balcony tiny behind
The balcony close up, sweeper cut off

quiz.question: A photographer wants to show a day in a hospital the way Bruegel shows the harvest. Which plan follows his method?
choices: Twelve monthly shots, one worker each, like a calendar
A grand shot of the surgeon at the moment of a cure
A portrait of the hospital's donor at lunch
One wide shot of staff working, eating, resting

quiz.question: A film-maker retells the Good Samaritan the way Caravaggio might. Which choice follows him?
choices: Robes on a desert road
Modern street, old robes
Today's clothes and street

quiz.question: A photographer wants a cleaner mopping a station floor to look dignified, the way Vermeer did. Which follows his method?
choices: From above, in bright light
Low angle, smiling at the lens
Close-up, chatting in a crowd
From below, absorbed in the work

quiz.question: A photographer wants an everyday moment worth a long look, the way Chardin does. Which shot follows his method?
choices: A crowd cheering a goal
A crying child, with a caption about sadness
A toy tower, caught as it falls
A girl threading a needle, close, unhurried

quiz.question: A film-maker wants to do what Courbet did. Which plan follows his method?
choices: A short, quiet film about one farm
A three-hour epic of a village council
A ten-hour series on Napoleon
A grand film of a state funeral

quiz.question: A photographer wants to do for today's poor what Millet did. Which picture follows his method?
choices: A food-bank queue, tiny figures far off
A full supermarket aisle, no people
Two women sorting leftovers, close up, a bare wall behind
Two women sorting leftovers, large in front, a full supermarket behind

quiz.question: A painter today wants to cause the same stir Caillebotte did. Which picture follows his method?
choices: A quick pencil sketch of a delivery rider
A huge, polished painting of a delivery rider at work
A huge, polished portrait of a famous general
A delivery rider painted beside a protest slogan

quiz.question: A photographer wants to show modern city life the way Manet does. Which shot follows his method?
choices: A still-faced cashier at a busy fair
A still-faced guest in a packed crowd
A smiling waiter at a busy fair
A close-up of a cashier counting coins

quiz.question: A painter wants a supermarket queue to feel as lasting as Seurat's park. Which picture follows his method?
choices: Shoppers caught mid-stride, like a photo
One shopper staring out at you
Shoppers posing, more on show than at ease
Each shopper still, carefully placed
